# Patrick Sang — Geospatial Software Developer

> Official portfolio: https://patrick-sang.is-a.dev/

Patrick Sang is a geospatial software developer based in Nairobi, Kenya, focused on turning spatial and complex data into useful software, maps, dashboards, and decision-support systems.

## Main resources

- [Homepage](https://patrick-sang.is-a.dev/): Services, selected projects, tools, workflow, and contact details.
- [Selected projects](https://patrick-sang.is-a.dev/buildss.html): GIS projects, prototypes, and geospatial experiments.
- [Professional journey](https://patrick-sang.is-a.dev/journeyy.html): Journey through spatial analysis and geospatial systems.
- [Lab](https://patrick-sang.is-a.dev/labb.html): Experimental/lab section; verify current page contents.
- [Geospatial writing](https://patrick-sang.is-a.dev/writingg.html): Blog/writing section; verify current page contents.

## Services

- **Geospatial data management and automation** — Spatial data creation, processing, governance, integration, validation, quality assurance, and workflow automation.
- **Geospatial analysis and visualization** — Spatial statistics, hotspot and pattern analysis, predictive spatial modelling, network and proximity analysis, and interactive visualization.
- **Remote sensing and Earth observation** — Satellite imagery analysis and monitoring of land use, land cover, agriculture, and environmental change.
- **Web GIS and application development** — Interactive web maps, location-based applications, web GIS platforms, and geoportal integrations.
- **Cartography and map production** — Interactive maps, digital map files, print-ready maps, atlases, and map collections.
- **GIS capacity building** — Training and support in GIS and remote-sensing methods for practical problem solving.

## Portfolio examples

- **Kenya County Budget Implementation — FY 2023/2024 Dashboard** — A county-level budget implementation dashboard shown in the portfolio.
- **Kenya Population Census 2024 Visualization** — A population data visualization project shown in the portfolio.
- **Kenya County Disability Visualization** — A county-level disability data visualization project shown in the portfolio.
- **Diaspora Remittance to Kenya — Multi-Year Analysis** — A multi-year remittance analysis project shown in the portfolio.

## Technology areas

- **Databases and spatial platforms:** PostgreSQL, PostGIS, DuckDB (Spatial and H3 extensions), AWS RDS, Amazon Athena
- **Programming:** Python, R, SQL, JavaScript, Node.js, Shell scripting
- **GIS and mapping:** QGIS, MapLibre GL JS, Leaflet, Folium, Kepler.gl, deck.gl, Overture Maps
- **Dashboards and BI:** Dash, FastAPI, Power BI, Looker Studio, Shiny, HTML reports
- **GeoAI and modelling:** scikit-learn, XGBoost, PySAL, TensorFlow, Suitability scoring, LISA
- **Spatial data formats:** GeoPackage, GeoParquet, Shapefile, CSV, H3, GeoJSON, JSON routing outputs
- **Remote sensing:** Sentinel-2, MODIS, Landsat, UAV/drone data, NDVI and spectral indices, Google Earth Engine
- **Data engineering:** Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Spark/Sedona, Docker, Git, ETL/ELT pipelines
- **Routing:** Jsprit, GraphHopper, OpenStreetMap, Vehicle routing, Multi-depot optimization
- **Intelligence and automation:** Claude API, Computer vision, n8n, LLMs

## Industries and use cases

The homepage references GIS use cases across business, insurance, healthcare, banking, real estate, sales and marketing, agriculture, retail, utilities and asset management, logistics, and monitoring and evaluation.
